eazy_data_viz · 经营驾驶舱组件总览
pandas → 单文件 HTML · Material Design 3 · 48 种图表 · 点击卡片右上角「代码」可查看生成该图的完整 Python 代码 · 点击图形可下钻 / 联动
联动筛选
① 核心指标 · KPI 与达成率
经营核心指标
2024 年全年 · 环比趋势
PYTHON
eazy_data_viz.group_kpi(
    items=[{"label": "总销售额", "value": 1631033.57, "fmt": "compact", "delta": 0.128}, {"label": "总利润", "value": 325738.59, "fmt": "compact", "delta": 0.086}, {"label": "订单数", "value": 2568, "fmt": "thousands", "delta": 0.064}, {"label": "利润率", "value": 19.9713, "fmt": "percent", "delta": -0.012}, {"label": "客户数", "value": 1922, "fmt": "thousands", "delta": 0.031}, {"label": "单均金额", "value": 635.1377, "fmt": "currency", "delta": 0.022}],
    title="经营核心指标",
    subtitle="2024 年全年 · 环比趋势",
    height=150,
)
PYTHON
eazy_data_viz.kpi(
    df,
    value="销售额",
    agg="sum",
    label="全年销售额",
    delta=0.128,
    delta_label="同比",
    target=2038791.9625,
    hint="2024 全年 · 含税",
    height=160,
)
PYTHON
eazy_data_viz.kpi(
    3.4,
    label="退货率（反向指标）",
    delta=-0.086,
    delta_label="同比",
    inverse=True,
    fmt="percent",
    hint="inverse=True：下降显示为绿色",
    height=160,
)
PYTHON
eazy_data_viz.kpi(
    df,
    value="销售额",
    agg="sum",
    label="销售额趋势卡",
    delta=0.041,
    delta_label="环比",
    spark="销售额",
    spark_x="月份",
    accent=1,
    link="g1",
    hint="迷你走势 + 参与 g1 联动",
    height=160,
)
PYTHON
eazy_data_viz.kpi(
    df,
    value="订单数",
    agg="sum",
    label="订单数",
    fmt="thousands",
    delta=0.064,
    delta_label="同比",
    unit=" 单",
    spark="订单数",
    spark_x="月份",
    accent=2,
    height=160,
)
